Job Description: 
 Title: ECM Infrastructure Engineer 
 Location: Jersey City, NJ 
 Duration:12+ Months 
  
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or Information Technology required
 Certification in ITIL
 Experience in prevailing industry architecture and engineering methodologies such as TOGAF or Zachman
 
 Experience 
 Must understand ECM infrastructure including how the products work internally.
 Five years of hands on experience engineering and implementing Filenet P8 including upgrades and fix packs
 Two years’ experience engineering and implementing Content Manager On Demand (CMOD)
 Three years’ experience in Datacap
 Experience with IBM Content Connector for SAP
 Strong Unix shell skills (Linux and Solaris) and Windows command line and skills
 Proficient in collaborating with 3rd party suppliers and partners.
 Experience in working with business leaders to understand business models, strategies, and priorities.
 Proven capabilities in influencing and negotiating priorities
  
 Skills 
 Excellent problem solving, communication, prioritization and organizational skills
 Execute with minimal direction
 Highly
 collaborative, team oriented and strong communicator with the ability 
to make decisions that are in the best interest of the organization
 Leadership skills to influence stakeholders and promote brand
 Ability to guide and mentor associates
 
 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 C2C
 
 USC/GC 
 
 
 DURATION: Long term
